name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 4 visits over 31 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2026-01-22, at wavelengths from 1.64 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
